purpose: Challenge the selected point-in-time profit-growth-versus-ROE rank gap against the complete 100-definition terminal library before any Campaign069 source row, candidate value, comparison value, daily price, or forward return is read.

selected_mechanism.name: quarterly_profit_growth_roe_transition_gap_2r
selected_mechanism.economic_hypothesis: A positive gap between profit YoY growth rank and current ROE rank represents an improving growth-to-profitability transition that may remain under-repriced over three sessions.
selected_mechanism.formula: r_profit_yoy-r_roe after strict-next-session availability, independent state propagation, and separate same-session average-tie percentile ranks on the common finite two-field cross-section.

overlap_challenges.reason: Each direct factor changes under a common shift of only its own rank, while the candidate measures their signed relative position. Both direct inputs remain mandatory numerical confounds; conceptual distinction is not treated as statistical proof.

Campaign066 rewards agreement among ROE, profit growth, and revenue growth regardless of which component leads. Campaign069 omits revenue growth and preserves the signed profit-growth-minus-ROE ordering.

Campaign067 subtracts absolute net-profit scale rank from ROE rank. Campaign069 reads no net_profit and instead subtracts ROE rank from profit_yoy growth rank; changing net-profit scale alone changes Campaign067 but not Campaign069.

Campaign069 requires no prior-period difference and reads current profit_yoy plus ROE. Campaign068 contrasts two same-quarter growth accelerations and is terminally rejected; none of its missing early states is filled or reinterpreted.
Campaign058 contrasts or aggregates profit and revenue growth. Campaign069 uses no revenue_yoy and instead contrasts profit growth with current profitability efficiency measured by ROE.
The candidate uses the current disclosed ROE state and no prior-period ROE difference. Equal current ROE can coexist with different ROE changes and vice versa.
Disclosure dates determine only when states become available; freshness, timeliness, delay consistency, and peer crowding do not enter the score.
Campaign069 reads no minute field, market path, leave-one-out benchmark, return, price, range, volume, amount, transaction price, or VWAP.
Candidate49 remains the sole prospective factor and counts close-versus-cumulative-VWAP crossings. Campaign069 is historical-only point-in-time accounting research and cannot backfill Candidate49.
Only two named already-exposed fields are combined with fixed rank semantics and coefficients +1/-1. No inverse, alternate pair, threshold, subset, year, regime, filter, weight, or model is selected.

counterfactual_checks.meaning: The candidate measures a relative transition gap, not common quality level.
The frozen sign distinguishes growth outrunning ROE from established ROE outrunning growth.
The score is not a re-expression or rescue of the three prior quarterly combinations.
The candidate cannot reproduce intraday mechanisms.

design_choices_frozen_before_values.availability: first accepted session strictly after announcement_date

decision.next_action: Freeze the Campaign069 coverage-first protocol, exact 98-cache-plus-Campaign068-snapshot comparator split, feature implementation, audit implementation, and tests before reading any Campaign069 value.
